reviews.author: Mike Workman
reviews.text: These guys are AWESOME!!! if you want it done right, these are the folks to ask. They did a 40x60 shop foundation with a 15x60 adjoining carport for me. They went out of there way to make sure my design was sound and I had the items I would need in the future. The work was efficient and well done and the job site was spotless after the job was complete. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND these folks for foundation work and I will not hesitate to use them again for future projects. If I could give them more than 5 stars I would.

reviews.author: Ronnie Johnson
reviews.text: Had royal do Concrete work at our Orange Co Volunteer Fire CO’s training facility and did fantastic work , easy to work with and they did things to make sure everyone was satisfied. The other thing that was so amazing about the whole ordeal is that Bob McConnell backed and supported the volunteer system and the things we do for our community and its citizens and guests that he donated all of his equipment, man hours and materials to make our facility more user friendly. Many thanks go out to Bob and his employees for a job so well done and for supporting us in our endeavors to move forward and train to be the best we can be for everything we do. Thanks from the Orange Co Volunteer Fire Chiefs Association President Ronald A. Johnson

reviews.author: Joseph Mangum
reviews.text: Called to see if the 15k I had put away was even in the ballpark for a new driveway before getting an official estimate and was told $1M and then treated like I was stupid. If your considering this company please be ready to be abused.

reviews.author: Robert Camper
reviews.text: My job was done on time, great quality of work, very responsive to my concerns, and at a very fair price! I would use them again.
